name: umg0-inspector-ui
description: Static frontend for `umg0 inspect`. Built output is committed to inspector-ui/dist and copied into dist/inspector/public by the root build.
comment: Versions are pinned exactly: scripts/check-inspector-assets.mjs compares a fresh build against the committed output, and a floating range would make that check fail on unrelated dependency drift. `motion` is installed but not yet imported — the prune replay needs its FLIP layout animations, and until then it is deliberately kept out of the bundle (~100 kB) that ships in the npm tarball.
